The input of servtuner boot-probe: a vLLM that booted with these knobs and no load. bench reads vllm:cache\_config\_info from its /metrics through the target's own hop and prints a tuningBootResult (boot-results.schema.json) with num\_gpu\_blocks and c\_kv = num\_gpu\_blocks x block\_size / tokens\_per\_request.

Schema file: `schema/json/boot-probe-request.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5730cfa50f08`.

## Top level

| Field                | Type                                                            | Required | Description                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `target`             | [target](/reference/runspec/#target)                            | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                 |
| `knobs`              | [tuningKnobSet](/reference/schemas/search-space/#tuningknobset) | Yes      | The knobs the target booted with; copied into the result.                                                                                       |
| `tokens_per_request` | `number`                                                        | Yes      | Mean prompt plus generated tokens per request of the session's workload: the planned means, since a boot probe has no measured requests. &gt; 0 |
